verdicts.title: Space key is swallowed during a match: pause-menu buttons and the instant-replays checkbox can't be used with Space, and the press is replayed as a pass or tackle on resume
verdicts.notes:
Reproduced on derby/main c59a889 with my own scripts (/tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f1space.cjs, f1root.cjs, f1hud.cjs). The reviewer's line numbers are stale. In current main the window keydown handler is src/client/input.ts:200-218: preventDefault for ' ' at :207, then this.pass or this.tackle is queued at :211-214. It never looks at e.target and never checks for pause. While paused the frame loop does not call input.take() (matchView.ts:343-347), so the queued kick fires on the first tick after resume.

What I measured:
- 2D: pause with Esc, Space on the focused #resume, and the overlay stays open. Ball still owner 9, speed 0 while paused. Enter resumes, and within about 25 ticks the ball has owner -1 at 10.75 m/s and control has moved to player 10: a pass I never asked for. 3D gives the same result (15.1 m/s).
- 3D, #opt-replays focused: true, then true after Space, then true after Enter. A mouse click toggles it. Tab order inside the card is resume, forfeit, opt-replays, wrapping.
- Root cause confirmed: I added a capture-phase listener that stops the game handler for Space on non-canvas targets. The checkbox then toggles (true to false) and Space on Resume closes the menu.
- During play, Space on the focused #hint-more leaves aria-expanded false (Enter makes it true), and Space on the focused #pause-btn does not pause (Enter does).

The checkbox exists only in this pause card (matchView.ts:137, 203-209), so keyboard-only players cannot change instant replays at all (WCAG 2.1.1). The phantom pass or tackle can lose possession or give away a foul. Only players who press Space while paused are affected, but for the keyboard scheme the pause menu looks broken.

Screenshot /tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f1-pause-3d.png shows the card with the checkbox.

Fix:
- (1) input.ts keydown: if the game is paused (pass an isPaused() callback from matchView.ts:171, as onPause is passed now), return before line 207. Do the same when e.target is a BUTTON, INPUT, SELECT, TEXTAREA or A other than the canvas, with no preventDefault and nothing queued, as shootout.ts already does ('let the focused button take it'). Escape/P handling stays first.
- (2) Add a clearOneShots() to InputController (pass, tackle, select, switchReq, shoot, loft, the charge starts). Call it from setPaused (matchView.ts:156-168) on both pause and resume, so nothing queued crosses a pause.
- (3) Add an e2e test in tests/e2e/match.e2e.cjs: pause, Space on Resume closes the menu and the ball stays at the player's feet. In 3D, Space on #opt-replays toggles it.

verdicts.title: Screen readers never hear most cards: 56% of yellows and 78% of reds are overwritten by the free-kick announcement in the same tick
verdicts.notes:
Reproduced:
- Headless: /tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/sim/cards.ts (bun) runs 60 CPU matches through the real step() and refereeCall(), with one render frame per tick and the last call per frame winning, as matchView does. 157 yellow calls, 98 never reach the live region (62%). 15 red calls, 12 never heard. Examples: seed 7 tick 3377 'Red card: M. Hartfeld' is replaced by 'Free kick to Sorstad United'. Seed 30 tick 15907 'Second yellow, red card: Y. Najsaouri' is replaced by 'Free kick to Kelvborough IF'. Some cards are also lost to another card in the same frame.
- Browser (/tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f2announce.cjs, 2D): I pushed foul, card and restart events in judgeFoul's order. A MutationObserver on #sr-announcer saw only ['Free kick to Wynby Rangers'], while the HUD banner read 'YELLOW CARD / G. SANNIADO' (/tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f2-banner.png).

Root cause:
- src/sim/rules.ts:408-410: issueCard runs before awardRestart, which pushes the restart event (rules.ts:144).
- src/client/matchView.ts:387-393 calls announce() once per event.
- src/client/a11y.ts:38-43: each announce() clears the previous 60 ms timer, so only the last text is ever written.
- Cards held back during advantage are flushed after the restart event (rules.ts:145), so those are heard.

Downgraded to minor. Only screen-reader users of a real-time, mouse-driven match are affected, and the card is shown visually. Their free-kick or penalty line still comes through.

Fix: in matchView.ts:387-393, collect this frame's refereeCall lines (cards first) together with the goal, half-time and full-time lines, and call announce() once with them joined, e.g. 'Yellow card: X. Free kick to Y.'. Alternatively, make announce() in a11y.ts append to a still-pending message instead of replacing it. Add a unit test that two announce() calls within 60 ms both reach the region.

verdicts.title: Colour-blind players can't tell the teams apart in about 1 in 10 kit pairings (crimson/green, red/green, green/orange); avoidClash only checks RGB distance
verdicts.notes:
Reproduced with my own script, /tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/py/cvd.py (Machado 2009 severity 1.0 in linear RGB, CIEDE2000). It runs over all 132 ordered pairs after a port of avoidClash (src/client/main.ts:264-274, swap only if the RGB distance is under 120).

Pairs with shirt ΔE00 below 12:
- normal vision: 0/132
- protanopia: 6/132
- deuteranopia: 10/132
- 7 of 66 unordered pairings in total

Worst pairs:
- #9f1239 vs #166534: deutan 2.8 (normal 62.6)
- #0b7a3e vs #9f1239: deutan 4.5
- #c8102e vs #166534: protan 6.3
- #0b7a3e vs #ea580c: protan 8.1
- #166534 vs #7c2d12: deutan 8.4

In 3D the shirt and socks use primary and the shorts use secondary (src/client/r3d/renderer3d.ts:381-385). Shorts save some pairs: green/yellow against crimson/light-blue has shorts ΔE about 52. The two genuinely unreadable cases:
- red/white vs green/white: same white shorts, protan shirt ΔE 6.3
- crimson/light-blue vs green/white: deutan shirt ΔE 2.8, shorts about 25

Live 3D screenshots, simulated (normal on top, CVD below):
- /tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f3-greencrimson-deutan.png and the zoomed /tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f3-greencrimson-zoom.png: both sides are dark olive shirts with light shorts.
- /tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f3-redgreen-protan.png: red vs green becomes 22 identical olive figures with white shorts.

The only non-colour cue on the pitch is the stamina bar over every human-team player during play, kickoff and restart (aim3d.ts:421, 433-435). It is about 22x2 px at 1280x800 and is hidden in replays. The radar is fine because it uses dots vs triangles.

Kept at major. Six of the 12 KIT_COLORS (src/meta/names.ts:269-273) appear in at least one clash, so many red-green colour-blind players will meet a match where the teams look the same.

Fix:
- In avoidClash (main.ts:264-274), replace the RGB test with a perceptual one. Count it as a clash if min(ΔE normal, ΔE protan-sim, ΔE deutan-sim) < ~20 on primaries, unless the shorts differ strongly. Then try the away secondary and the neutral kits under the same test. Export it for a unit test over all KIT_COLORS pairs.
- Optionally add a stronger team cue in aim3d.ts (for example a small marker shape or a visible bar on both sides) or a colour-blind kits option.

verdicts.title: Phone HUD targets are far below 44 px and tightly stacked: Menu is 76x23, the Cam chip 71x16 sits 4 px below it, and a near-miss tap on Menu flips the camera
verdicts.notes:
Reproduced with /tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f4phone.cjs: 390x844, DPR 3, isMobile, hasTouch, (pointer: coarse) matches, 3D.

Measured targets:
- #pause-btn: 75.7x23 at y22-45
- #cam-btn: 71.4x16 at y49-65, a 4 px gap from Menu
- zoom buttons: 32x32 at y69-101
- .juice-mute: 28x28
- Pass/Shoot pads: 66x66

Taps at Menu's centre x:
- 2 px below Menu's bottom edge: lands on the pitch
- 4, 6 and 10 px below: hit #cam-btn and toggle side/end camera, no pause
- Menu's centre: pauses

The rules responsible are hud.css:97 (.hud-tr gap 4px), :102 (.hud-menu padding 3px 6px), :105 (.pitch-cam padding 3px 6px) and :111 (juice-mute 28px). The 'Esc' kbd also shows on touch. Crop: /tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f4-phone-hudtr.png; full screenshot: /tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f4-phone.png.

Downgraded to minor. Menu works when tapped accurately, and a mis-tap only flips the camera, which another tap undoes. It is still below the 44 px guideline and is the only way to pause on a phone.

Fix: in hud.css under @media (pointer: coarse):
- give .hud-menu, .pitch-cam and .pitch-zoom button min-height 40-44px (or an invisible ::before hit area with inset:-8px)
- raise the .hud-tr gap to at least 8px, or put Cam and zoom in a row beside Menu
- give .pitch-wrap .juice-mute 44px
- hide .hud-menu kbd

verdicts.title: The mouse cursor is hidden on the pitch, and its replacement, the orange ground ring, has 1.15:1 contrast against the grass (1.08:1 for protanopia)
verdicts.notes:
Confirmed:
- src/client/styles.css:615 sets cursor:none on #pitch.
- src/client/r3d/aim3d.ts:193 draws the pointer as RingGeometry(0.42, 0.56) in ORANGE #ff8a1c (:36) with no outline.

Measured with my own scripts (/tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f5measure.cjs, py/ring2.py), no ball, everyone frozen, 1280x800 3D. The ring is about 29x19 px.
- Light stripe: ring rgb(234,141,31) on grass rgb(56,160,50). Luminance contrast 1.31-1.33:1; protan 1.03-1.06:1; deutan about 1.5:1.
- Dark stripe: about 1.9:1; protan 1.55:1.

In /tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f5-m2-cvd.png (normal on top left, protan below it, deutan on the right) the ring is plainly visible for normal vision. It nearly vanishes under protanopia and is faint under deuteranopia.

Downgraded to minor. The low luminance ratio overstates the problem for normal vision, because orange on green has strong colour contrast and is easy to see (/tmp/rt/a11y-verify/out/f5-m2-crop.png). The real harm falls on protan and, to a lesser degree, deutan players without the ball; with the ball the white reticle helps.

Fix: in aim3d.ts near :193, add a dark under-ring (RingGeometry(0.36, 0.62), rgba(0,0,0,.6), renderOrder 4) under the orange one, and/or a thin white inner ring, matching how name tags and the marker are outlined. Alternatively use a light, high-luminance colour with a dark edge.
